headline: Indian Emulsifiers wins Rs 111.82 Cr order from USA Customer
summary: IEML secures Rs 111.82 Cr specialty chemical order from USA Customer. This follows Rs 74.20 Cr inflow in Q2FY27. Book-to-bill context and execution trends analyzed.

headline: Aristo Bio-Tech wins Rs 1.98 Cr order from DVA Agro
summary: Aristo Bio-Tech & Lifescience secured a Rs 1.98 Cr purchase order from Germany-based DVA Agro GmbH for Profenophos supply. The deal represents significant inflow relative to recent disclosures, with cash-against-delivery terms mitigating receivable risks.

headline: Kheria Autocomp wins Rs 12 Cr order from Yanfeng for MG Hector
summary: Kheria Autocomp secured a Rs 12 crore work order from Yanfeng India Automotive Interior Systems for MG Hector Tomahawk door trim parts. Execution begins April 2027.

headline: Transteel wins Rs 4.62 crore order from Vestian Global
summary: Transteel Seating receives confirmed work order for furniture supply from Vestian Global Workplace Services. Order value is Rs 461.61 lakh, classified as significant.

headline: BMISL wins Rs 6.67 Cr AI AV order from Govt
summary: Bench Mark Infotech Services secures Rs 6.67 Cr order for AI-based audio-visual systems in High Courts and Govt depts across Bihar, UP, MP. Book-to-bill ratio remains high given limited historical revenue visibility.
